sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: This is one of those days when not goes well, warns Ganesha. No matter how hard you try you may not be able to keep problems and difficulties at bay. You may not be pleased or comfortable doing what has been assigned, or required, and could simply sit sullenly, doing nothing. Do not, therefore, take up anything difficult or complex. Stick to simple and easy things. Knowing that this day will pass, you should try to remain positive and optimistic.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: It's time to take your communication to the next level, Taurus. Expand outward and upward. For the last three weeks you've gone through a serious mental process that has helped you define what you stand for and believe in. Now you're in a phase that urges you to put these ideas into motion. The expansive quality of the day is profound, so take advantage of it and get moving.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Take time to beautify your world and the work you produce, dearest Taurus, as Venus rx aligns with the nodes of fate. This energy is all about investing in your home, health, and career to reach your highest potential. A sweet aspect between the Scorpio Sun and Cancer Moon harmonizes your mind, making it easier to let down your guard and connect. Just remember: maintain a healthy level of mystery while Luna squares Saturn.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: A day when rest will be important- As you have been facing lot of mental pressure recently-  Recreation and entertainment will help you relax. Today, you can take your family members out for a get-together and spend a lot of money on them. Your brother will be more supportive to your needs than you had thought. Today you will have the stamina and the know-how to raise your earning power. Today, you will have ample time to spend with your spouse. Your spouse might become insensitive toward your health today.

readings.text: Your gift of the gab will come handy today in all verbal communications related to work, whether it’s a meeting or any informal discussion. The practical view will be helpful in solving complex problems whereas emotional opinions will catch the attention of your superior to explore new opportunities.

Overall, the day will go smoothly, and you will receive tremendous emotional support for the work that you are doing. Others are able to sympathize with what you are going through - for better or for worse - and this is making your job much easier.

readings.text: You may feel confused about your financial future and may start speculating over various aspects related to your income. However, the day will also require other types of action on your part.

You have energy directed toward groups, politics, and self-employment. You have all the friends and contacts you need to begin a new venture, whether product, service, or project at your current job. You will also meet new people who can help you get where you want to be financially. At the same time, you're augmenting and transforming your union with other people. You have all the tools you need to get ahead.
